outcome: Non-transfusion-dependent chronic hemolytic anemia state later in life resembling mild b-thalassemia intermedia
cohort: The study describes a novel genetic deletion and its clinical manifestations across three generations of a Greek family.
finding: A novel 72kb deletion encompassing the entire b-globin gene cluster caused severe but transient neonatal anemia and a non-transfusion-dependent chronic hemolytic anemia resembling mild b-thalassemia intermedia later in life.
followup_time: Later in life (specific duration not mentioned)
